requirement_text: The application must be fully loaded and ready for use within a maximum of 2 seconds after startup.
requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to load within two seconds so that I can use it without delay.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the app is closed, When I start the app on a supported device, Then the app must be fully loaded and ready for use within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application must run quickly and smoothly during use.
requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly"

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to run smoothly so that I have a responsive experience.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I navigate through core app features, When screens and modules are used under normal operating conditions, Then the app must respond smoothly without noticeable performance degradation.

requirement_text: The user interface must enable direct access to information.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."

user_story.story: As a user, I want information to be directly accessible through the interface so that I can find content efficiently.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I open the app, When I navigate to major content areas, Then the interface must allow direct access to the information provided by the app.

requirement_text: The application's modules and user interface must remain consistent despite external server updates.
requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app interface and modules to remain consistent even when server data changes so that my experience stays stable.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the external server updates its data, When the app retrieves updated content, Then the available modules and user interface structure must remain consistent.

requirement_text: Registration and login must be uncomplicated for users.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated"

user_story.story: As a user, I want registration and login to be uncomplicated so that I can access the app with minimal effort.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am at startup, When I attempt to register or log in, Then I must be able to complete the process through a straightforward startup flow without unnecessary steps.

requirement_text: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to work reliably with poor connectivity so that I can still use it in difficult network conditions.
user_story.Acceptance: Given network coverage is limited, When I use core app features, Then the application must continue to function reliably.

requirement_text: The application must remain usable offline during temporary connection loss.
requirement_reference: "The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to remain usable offline during temporary disconnections so that I can continue using it without interruption.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am using the app and the connection is lost temporarily, When I continue interacting with the app, Then the app must remain usable offline.

requirement_text: The application must support up to 100,000 simultaneous users on match days without performance loss.
requirement_reference: "On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want the app to perform well even during peak match-day traffic so that I can access it reliably.
user_story.Acceptance: Given peak match-day load conditions, When up to 100,000 users access the system simultaneously, Then the system must continue serving users without performance loss.

requirement_text: The application must undergo thorough testing and support before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.story: As a business stakeholder, I want the app thoroughly tested and supported before release so that malfunctions are identified early.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a release candidate is prepared, When it enters the pre-release process, Then it must undergo thorough testing and support activities to identify and resolve malfunctions before release.

requirement_text: The product team must continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.
requirement_reference: "In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality."

user_story.story: As a product stakeholder, I want user feedback and app reviews continuously evaluated so that the app can be improved over time.
user_story.Acceptance: Given user feedback and app reviews are received, When the improvement process is performed, Then the feedback and reviews must be continuously evaluated for functionality improvements.

requirement_text: The system must process all personal data in compliance with GDPR.
requirement_reference: "Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.story: As a user, I want my personal data processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy rights are protected.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the system collects or processes personal data, When personal data handling occurs, Then the processing must comply with GDPR requirements.
